quests.title: Adventurous Acquaintance

dialogue.section: Go to the front desk of the Adventurers' Guild

dialogue.t: Ah, it's you! Didn't think I'd be running into you here... Hehe, I guess it's my lucky day...
How're your adventures going lately? Did you come here to get a new commission from Katheryne, or to get paid?
And where're you going after this? Bet you've got a really exciting adventure lined up, huh?

dialogue.sit: You are...?

dialogue.t: The name's Bennett. I'm your run-of-the-mill adventurer from Mondstadt!

dialogue.sit: Nice to meet you, Bennett!

dialogue.t: Ah... I'm talking too much, aren't I... I'm sorry...
I was just so excited to run into someone I admire so much... And, uh... maybe a little starstruck, too... haha...

dialogue.sit: You... admire me?

dialogue.t: Of course! You're the mysterious Traveler, the hero who quelled the Stormterror crisis, and the leader of your own adventure team to boot!
If I'm being honest... I'm totally jealous of all your achievements...

dialogue.sit: {NICKNAME}'s Adventure Team...

dialogue.t: Yeah, word's been spreading in adventurer circles for a long time now. Your adventure team shows up all over the continent...
It might look like you're just handling a bunch of boring commissions, but then, as soon as something big goes down, you're always there!

dialogue.sit: That's just coincidence...

dialogue.t: Anyway, I just really envy you. You're sort of like... the protagonist of this world, or something. Hahaha...
Me, on the other hand, I'm just some unlucky guy. My adventure team even...
Ah— never mind, I shouldn't get all down in the dumps in front of someone I admire. I should be open to see what I can learn!
Speaking of which... I have a favor to ask...
Um... when you go adventuring later, can I come and watch?

dialogue.sit: ...You just want to stand there and watch?
Aren't you going to give me a hand!?

dialogue.t: Eh-hehe... Maybe you don't know. I'm a really unlucky person to have around...
If you brought me along on an adventure, my bad luck would probably just screw everything up!
I don't want to get you into any trouble, so just let me watch from the sidelines... that'd be good enough for me...

dialogue.sit: You're that excited to see me...?
I have my reasons...

dialogue.t: Hmm? Something else?
...I guess you're right. Even just the chance to talk with you would be great, too. Yeah... let's forget about adventuring for now, hah...
But, uh... what would we do instead?
Apart from going on adventures... the only other thing I do is take care of my dads in the Adventurers' Guild...
So... I really can't think of anything else to do besides adventuring.

dialogue.sit: Let me think about it.

dialogue.t: Alright! I feel like whatever we do, as long as you're involved, it'll be totally worth it!
Uh... but don't forget, I'll be bringing my bad luck with me...
So it probably won't be a very fun trip... haha...

dialogue.sit: It won't bother me.
I'm looking forward to it.
As long as you don't cause too much trouble.

dialogue.t: That's good, that's good... I was afraid you'd back out.
Really? Looking forward to hanging out with someone like me...?
Seems like the rumors are all true! You really are a nice person able to bring people together, hehe.
Oh, I, uh... I'll try, although most of the time it's completely out of my control...
So, where are we gonna go?

dialogue.sit: How about we hang out around town?
How about a walk in the wild?

dialogue.t: Cool, that would be nice! I was planning to stock up on some adventuring supplies anyway...
Oh! Sorry, I'm back talking about adventuring again. You must think I'm so boring...
Really!? Well, of course you do. You are a famous adventurer, after all.
How about we go to the souvenir store?
"With Wind Comes Glory" is my favorite shop ever. What can I say, Mondstadt's where I grew up.
Let's go!
Oh, um... a—alright, haha...
How about we go to the souvenir store?
"With Wind Comes Glory" is my favorite shop ever. What can I say, Mondstadt's where I grew up.
Let's go!
That's a good idea!
For someone like me, I'm actually way more familiar with the wilderness than the city, especially around Mondstadt!
I mean, I'm not on the same level as Fischl, who is also in the Adventurers' Guild. But that's expected, because she works in the Intelligence Department.
Oh, I know this gorgeous place. It's sort of a dandelion-covered meadow.
It's got a great Mondstadt feel. Do you want to check it out?

dialogue.sit: Can't wait!
I can accompany you for a quick look.

dialogue.t: Awesome! I was worried that it wouldn't be your thing...
Shall we?
Uh... okay, I'll try not to let you down, haha...
Shall we?
Really? I didn't mishear you, did I?
You mean... go adventure with you, just like we'd do if I was on your adventure team?
Wow! I never thought I'd get an opportunity like this!

dialogue.sit: Come on, I'm not as great as you make out...
I've always wanted to go adventuring with you, too.

dialogue.t: Don't be so modest! I've heard about all the great things you've done, not to mention the high praise you get from the Adventurers' Guild...
Aw, shucks... hearing you say that has got me all flustered, hehe... but I'm happy to hear it!
...By the way, since we've got this rare chance to work together, let me share some recent intel with you!
According to my friend Fischl in the Guild, a mysterious and dangerous ruin has recently been discovered...
Based on how the Guild ranks the difficulty of its commissions, it's probably between a Rank B and a Rank A.
Normally, I wouldn't feel confident about taking on this level of commission...
After all, with my poor luck, it's safer for me to take on commissions that are a few notches lower than my actual ability, haha.
But since you'll be joining me this time, it'll be a piece of cake, right?

dialogue.sit: Does defeating Stormterror count as an S-rank commission?

dialogue.t: Of course! Defeating Stormterror puts you on par with Guild Master Cyrus in my mind.

dialogue.sit: Would stealing the Holy Lyre der Himmel count as an S-rank commission?

dialogue.t: There's no way the Guild would issue an illegal commission like that!
Heh... By the way, this ruin might be a dangerous one, but that usually means there'll be some great treasure hidden inside. I can't wait!
Oh, uh... do you usually make some food before you set out on an adventure?

dialogue.sit: I do.

dialogue.t: Hmm... the cautious choice. No wonder you're so good at this.
Seems I really can learn a few things from you, hehe.
In that case, as per your tradition, let's get cooking!
Oh yeah — I actually invented a pretty nice dish recently!
I can't say it's super tasty, but I think it'd be perfect for an adventure. So, how about I show you how to make it?

dialogue.sit: Okay, how about I fetch the ingredients and you cook?

dialogue.t: Cool! I really miss that old feeling of working with a partner.

dialogue.sit: Nice, and thank you!

dialogue.t: Oh wait till you see— Oh, uh... huh. Ingredients... seem to be in short supply, hehe...
I'm really sorry... I probably need your help to get some.
The ingredients needed for this dish are... Mint, Radish, and Slime Condensate. One of each, please.
You got that, right? I'll wait for you near the pot at Good Hunter. Come find me when you're done collecting!
Oh! I guess you're such a pro that you don't need to worry about that, huh? Awesome...
Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!

quests.description: You make the acquaintance of a rather passionate adventurer at the front desk of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild...

quests.title: Something... Other Than Adventure?

dialogue.section: Go to With Wind Comes Glory

dialogue.t: Marjorie!
Oh, hello, Bennett! I haven't seen you for a long time. I thought you were off adventuring in some faraway place that I've never heard of.
Hehe, no, no, it's just I got myself into a tight spot out there. Ended up getting held up for quite a while...
Ahaha... what else is new? So, what are you looking to buy this time?
Oh, I was just checking in to see if the stuff I ordered last time was ready. Thought I'd bring my friend along.
You mean "Herman's Custom Adventure Map"...
That's right! An adventure map drawn personally by Herman, the great adventurer. It shows loads of recommended places for adventuring, and with his comments, too!
Well, it did arrive, but unfortunately, the cart tipped over in a puddle on the way here...
Most of the goods were fine, but since the adventure map was an ink drawing, it's completely ruined...
What... oh, shoot! That's such a shame!

dialogue.sit: You really are unlucky, Bennett...

dialogue.t: Aw, I'd been looking forward to that for so long... I was this close to getting my hands on it...

dialogue.sit: Poor Marjorie...

dialogue.t: Yes, I am the one who has to bear the loss, after all...
(*sigh* Maybe I should reconsider whether I'm happy to accept orders from Bennett in the future...)
Okay, well, do you have any Alchemist's Goggles?
I've been thinking about replacing the old goggles on my head for a long time. I heard that there's a new type of goggles made specially for alchemists!
When you wear them, you can see all the elements, even the slightest traces of elemental energy!

dialogue.sit: That's quite useful.
I feel like I can do all of that already...

dialogue.t: Oh... I'm afraid these "Alchemist's Goggles" you refer to are just a rumor...
I talked to that alchemist, Timaeus... He told me there's no such thing.
Ugh, are you kidding me? My hopes dashed, yet again...
Well... how about some Slime Gel Gloves? They exist, right? I saw an adventurer using them once.
No matter what the weather, they can grip onto rock when climbing. I call them... non-slip gloves.
Those do exist...
Unfortunately, we sold out of them just yesterday. They are quite a popular product.

dialogue.sit: I don't think we are going to get anything here...

dialogue.t: Haha... It's okay, no big deal! I'm pretty much used to coming home empty-handed when I go shopping.
Don't let it bother you. Oh — hey, how about I treat you to a meal at Good Hunter?
We've been hanging out for a while now, you must be getting hungry, right? Let's go!

dialogue.sit: Let's head somewhere else...

dialogue.section: Go to With Wind Comes Glory

dialogue.t: Mondstadt General Goods Special Offer — 50% Off All Items!
Hi, Sara! Table for two, please!
Ah... I'm so sorry, I don't think we'll be able to serve you two today.
Huh? How come? It doesn't seem really busy here.
Ahh... well... how can I put this, just before you two arrived, we received an order...
An entire delegation from Snezhnaya has come to stay at the Goth Grand Hotel, and they asked us to provide a meal service.
So, although you might not see many people here, the kitchen is in fact busier than it's ever been.
*sigh* They really know how to rope people into doing things for them. If only they hadn't offered to pay so much...

dialogue.sit: Looks like we'll have to give up...

dialogue.t: Yeah, who'd have thought we'd have so much trouble just trying to get some food...

dialogue.sit: I'll bet it's those pesky Fatui again!

dialogue.t: Oh. I've actually never had any dealings with them...
But I have heard that they're arrogant and aggressive.
In which case, there probably isn't much we can do about it...
Well... how 'bout we just head to Mondstadt General Goods? We can at least get some basic adventure supplies!
What do you think? You're in, right? Hehe, let's go.
Huh, that's strange... the owner, Blanche, isn't here. Hmm... That's really rare.
Let's go over there and see what that sign says.
Wow! Is this for real? A discount!?

dialogue.sit: This store's generally not considered tight-fisted, is it?
Don't most places have a sale every now and then?

dialogue.t: I mean, sure, but... not when I'm around!
I've never had such good luck before!
Heh, it must be because I'm with you! Wow, lucky folk really have it different.

dialogue.sit: That's a bit of an exaggeration...

dialogue.t: Hehe, you're so nice.
Then again, any discount's a bit meaningless without Blanche being here.
Shall we wait here for a while?
When Blanche comes back, I'm gonna buy a bunch!
After all, this is a rare opportunity, especially for someone like me...
*sigh* Blanche is taking quite a while...
It must be an emergency. I feel like she hardly ever leaves the counter.

dialogue.sit: Let's wait a little longer...
I have a bad feeling about this...

dialogue.t: Really? Don't worry. If we managed to catch a sale, today's gotta be a good day!
Patience is a virtue for adventurers, too! There's no rush...
Do you think that... Blanche is in some kind of trouble?
I'm getting a bit worried... The 50% discount is a big deal, but... compared to Blanche's safety, I mean...

dialogue.sit: You are overthinking things...
Yeah, it's been too long...

dialogue.t: Hmm... It's probably just all this waiting around making my imagination run wild, I guess...
Ugh... C'mon, snap out of it...
I don't usually say this...
But... do you think it's time we gave up...?
Blanche probably won't be back today, right?
I guess I overestimated my luck, haha...

dialogue.sit: It's just a coincidence...

dialogue.t: That's right, I shouldn't let myself get down about it...
I'm sorry, I got so obsessed with the idea of that discount that I didn't stop to consider your feelings...
Oh... are you... waiting for me?
Blanche! We've been waiting for you for ages. You're finally back!
I was getting worried about you... What happened? Did you run into some kind of trouble?
Oh... Nothing like that. I was just sorting some things out at home. Thanks for your concern, though.
But, why are you two waiting anyway? I posted a notice saying that we'd be closed today...
Closed!?
We didn't see a sign like that... And anyway, isn't it 50% off the whole store today? That's the whole reason we waited all this time.
Uh, let me check...
Hmm... that's weird. It looks like someone removed the closed sign. Or... maybe the wind blew it away?
The half price notice you saw was for yesterday... Sorry about that.
Oh...

dialogue.sit: Cheer up, Bennett...
This is so you, Bennett...

dialogue.t: I'm sorry... I should have seen this coming...
So, so, sorry! I feel like I've done nothing but waste your time all day...
No matter what I do, I really can't shake my bad luck...
*sigh* It's getting a bit late. I don't think you can accomplish anything if you keep on hanging out with me...
So... let's part ways for now, and maybe next time it'll be different...
...That is, if you still want to hang out with me next time... heh...
Thanks... I'm fine. I should have seen this coming...

quests.description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... running around the city?

quests.title: What Is This, a Day Trip?

dialogue.sit: Is this definitely the right place?
It's not quite what I expected...

dialogue.t: Ah... what happened? It wasn't like this the last time I saw it!
The dandelions are all stripped bare of seeds...
Was there a wind storm? Or did some strange creature come by...
I'm so sorry... bringing you all this way only for you to end up seeing nothing...

dialogue.sit: You couldn't have predicted this, no need to apologize.

dialogue.t: Well, that's true... but then again, the unpredictable is to be expected when my luck's involved...
Really? You're not just saying that because you don't wanna hurt my feelings, are you? Heh, you're so nice.
You're right, I just got careless. With my poor luck, I should have been extra careful... sorry about that.
Well, there's not much reason to stay here anymore.
But, how about we take a walk around the area? Maybe we'll find something interesting.
...Is that it!? What a letdown.
Isn't that the peak of Starsnatch Cliff up ahead?
The view goes for miles from up there. I bet you've been here before, right? ... Come on, let's go!
How come the weather suddenly brightened up the second Bennett left?
Hey! Do you see that? There's a monster camp up ahead!
I can see a whole load of treasure chests with no monsters guarding them!

dialogue.sit: That's rare...

dialogue.t: I was hoping I'd get a chance to flex my muscles a bit! Where did all the monsters go? This is weird.
For me, this kind of good fortune is super rare. It must be because you're here, hehe.
Let's go check it out! Ooh... I wonder what goodies are hidden in those chests?

dialogue.sit: It feels a bit off...

dialogue.t: Whew... we didn't miss any, right?

dialogue.sit: How can this be!
I can't believe there was nothing good at all...
No wonder there were no monsters guarding them...

dialogue.t: Hmm? What's the problem?
We got so much stuff today! We should be happy... How come you look so down?

dialogue.sit: Does that mean you usually...
Surely not...

dialogue.t: Hmm? Chests are always like this, aren't they?
A few loose Mora, occasionally a cabbage, maybe a radish or something.
A bit of Mora and some ingredients to fill our stomachs, that's good enough for me!
The kind of chests you mentioned that have weapons, artifacts, or some other treasures inside...
Aren't they super, super rare?
I've only ever seen them in places that are so dangerous you'd have to risk life and limb to get there...
So that's how it is!? ...Ugh, and I actually thought this was the norm.
I can't believe even chests are after me... hmph.
Let's keep walking. Who knows when the monsters might return.
Shall we?
Right? So let's not ask for too much.
Let's keep walking. Who knows when the monsters might return.
Shall we?
It's so nice here. The breeze is so comforting... Really lifts my mood.
I've been adventuring alone for a long time. It feels so nice to have company. Honestly, I miss it a lot, hehe.
Oh, uh, not that I'm super lonely or anything. I've got my dads to keep me company when I'm not out adventuring.
Actually... did I tell you about my dads already?
Back in the day, they were all great adventurers. They've got so many cool stories.
They were the ones who rescued me from a perilous place when I was just a baby, and together they raised me.
Now they're all old and frail. Some of them can't even walk by themselves anymore. So it's my turn to take care of them.
I'd love to take you to meet them sometime. You'd be blown away by some of their stories!
Absolutely! I picked up most of my adventure expertise from them. They're incredible!
By the way, you did bring a wind glider with you today, right?
The weather is so nice and the wind speed is perfect. Why don't we take the chance to go for a glide?
Aww...

dialogue.sit: What happened to the weather...
Your bad luck is getting ridiculous!

dialogue.t: Eh-he... sorry, I didn't see this coming... not to this extent, at least.
Well, it seems that we'd better give up on that idea. Let's go do something else...
Bennett! So there you are!
Hi, Jack! Is something going on? Are you here to see me?
Some of the older adventurers in the guild are really hurting from their arthritis again... it could be because of the humidity today...
You mean my dads? That's too bad. They'll need someone to take care of them.
Well, you're the one who usually looks after them, right? They're all asking for you!
Okay, I'll be right over!
O—Oh, wait...

dialogue.sit: It's okay, this is important.
I'll see you next time we get a chance.

dialogue.t: Yeah, thanks for understanding. Though, I feel pretty bad leaving you here...
We'd better hurry back. They're all waiting for you.
Okay... okay, sure. Well... I have to go now. Let me treat you to something next time... bye...
No, not really! I mean, I have to be careful to make sure they don't get affected by my bad luck, but apart from that, it's kinda fun taking care of them!
By the way, you did bring a wind glider with you today, right?
The weather is so nice and the wind speed is perfect. Why don't we take the chance to go for a glide?
Aww...

dialogue.sit: What happened to the weather...
Your bad luck is getting ridiculous!

dialogue.t: Eh-he... sorry, I didn't see this coming... not to this extent, at least.
Well, it seems that we'd better give up on that idea. Let's go do something else...
Bennett! So there you are!
Hi, Jack! Is something going on? Are you here to see me?
Some of the older adventurers in the guild are really hurting from their arthritis again... it could be because of the humidity today...
You mean my dads? That's too bad. They'll need someone to take care of them.
Well, you're the one who usually looks after them, right? They're all asking for you!
Okay, I'll be right over!
O—Oh, wait...

dialogue.sit: It's okay, this is important.
I'll see you next time we get a chance.

dialogue.t: Yeah, thanks for understanding. Though, I feel pretty bad leaving you here...
We'd better hurry back. They're all waiting for you.
Okay... okay, sure. Well... I have to go now. Let me treat you to something next time... bye...

quests.description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... having a stroll in the great outdoors?

quests.title: Treacherous Thermadon

dialogue.t: Now that we've got our ingredients, allow me to handle the cooking!
It's done!
I forgot the exact order you're supposed to add the ingredients in, but... it should be alright.
I'll pack it up and leave it with you until we get to the ruins.

dialogue.sit: Are you sure it's okay to eat?

dialogue.t: I think so...? Should be... pretty much... basically the same as when I first came up with it. So... yup!

dialogue.sit: I feel like this dish... reeks of misfortune.

dialogue.t: Huh? It's just an ordinary dish... hearing you say that is really kind of disappointing...
Well, now that the food is ready, let's head for those mysterious ruins!
It feels pretty ordinary here... I was expecting some kind of sense of impending doom.
Could it be that because you're here with me, I'm feeling more at ease? Hehe...
Ahh, it looks like... the door in the front is closed and only the door behind us is open...
That mechanism must be for opening the next door, right?

dialogue.sit: I think so.
Well, that's pretty much our only option.

dialogue.t: Right. Well, we're on the same page at least.
I'll go try to operate it.
Just as I expected, hehe.

dialogue.sit: But now the door behind us is closed...

dialogue.t: Ah, so it is...
Hmm... a true adventurer can't just barge on forward. It's also important to make sure there is a way back. That's what my dads always say.
Lemme try the mechanism one more time...
*clicking sounds*
Hmm, it seems to be... jammed.

dialogue.sit: Not what I expected, but not exactly unexpected.

dialogue.t: This is not good... It seems that we can't get back the way we came.

dialogue.sit: Does that mean... we're locked in here?

dialogue.t: I think so, at least, it seems that way for now...
But, don't let it get you down!
This kind of thing happens all the time. We just have to believe that there's always a way out.
What the... What's going on...
Hey, did you hear that?
Sounded like it came from the door up ahead of us... Could there be other people in the ruin, too?
Let's go check it out!
Have you found a way out yet? ... Forget it, why did I even get my hopes up, anyway?
Hello, fellow adventurer! We, like you, are here to—
...BENNETT!?
Ah— Royce...!? It's you!
Oh no, oh please, oh no, no, no...
I'm so happy to see you again! How are you doing? I've been thinking about you and the other guild members a lot recently...
This is the worst! Ugh... Why did I have to run into you...
Oh...
It took me forever to get this door open! Finally, I was about to advance further in, and all of a sudden... it closes again.
Ah, I guess that's because I activated the mechanism just now...
I knew it, I knew it! Of course it was you, I knew it as soon as I saw you.
As long as you are around, no adventure can ever be a smooth ride! Ugh... This is turning into a very bad day...

dialogue.sit: That's a bit harsh, isn't it?
How can you blame it all on someone else?

dialogue.t: Who are you? And what the heck were you thinking, teaming up with Bennett!
Hey! Don't fight, don't fight...
{NICKNAME}, let me introduce Royce, a former member of Benny's Adventure Team, and... an old friend of mine.
Friend!? I didn't even tell you I was leaving the team, and you still think of me as... your friend...?
Ugh, never mind, I'm a little on edge because of what just happened. I'm sorry.
Well, it was my fault... haha...
Ya think? *sigh* I left because at that time, I really couldn't stand it a second longer. My adventures always used to go off without a hitch...
But after joining your adventure team, I was tripping and falling one day, getting struck by lightning the next— Oh, and the number of times ruins would cave in on us...
I just couldn't dismiss it as "mere coincidence" anymore...

The last straw was when my left leg got hit by that random explosion that came out of nowhere. After that, I couldn't stand it anymore... both literally and figuratively. *sigh* So I left... and went back to being an independent adventurer...
Only afterward did I start hearing the horror stories about Benny's Adventure Team... *sigh*

dialogue.sit: Bennett didn't volunteer for this bad luck.
So that's why you left him?

dialogue.t: I didn't think about it much at the time, I was just focused on my own survival, but... there was no other way...
Alright, alright, it's all in the past now. Talking about all the bad things that happened will only make you more upset, right?
Um... Royce... I still want to say sorry for all the trouble I caused you...
Oh... no need to apologize to me. I have made my fair share of mistakes, too...
Oh! Yeah... there's one more thing I need to tell you. The door we came through on the way in also got closed, and... I don't think we can get it open again.
So we are probably trapped here now. What a pain in the butt, haha...
BENNETT!!!
Ugh! Everything always goes wrong when I'm with you!
Oh... well... there's nothing I can do... sorry.
Ugh, what am I gonna do!? I've used up all of my supplies already!
This is it... This is how I go, isn't it...? Here, today, and all because of Bennett... *whimpers*
Well... I don't know what I could do to apologize. If you don't mind, maybe we can share some of our supplies with you.
Ah, but of course, I'll have to check with my partner first. So, what do you think?
...You're right, I really shouldn't have put the blame on him like that.

dialogue.sit: No way. You don't owe him anything.

dialogue.t: Ugh... alright... I am quite hungry. I suppose I shall accept your kind offer.
...Is this the "supplies" you were talking about? Why do I have the feeling that this dish is... a bit suspect?
It's fine, honestly! It's been with my partner all along, so it shouldn't be tainted with my bad luck...
If that's true then... okay. Anyway, this is not a time to nitpick.
Then... I guess I'll just have... little bite...
Hmm, tastes a little... Huh, what a strange texture... Ugh, what is that churning feeling in my stomach...
...B—Bennett...
Hey, what's wrong? Royce!
But it was because of my bad luck, though...

dialogue.sit: This is why you should focus on yourself more.
Stop trying to accommodate others all the time.

dialogue.t: So you mean... as the unlucky one, I should think of myself more...

dialogue.sit: Bennett, you did nothing wrong.
If you only think about caring for others, who will take care of you?

dialogue.t: Heh... You do have a point there...
It's just, I've been used to thinking this way for a long time. Hearing you say that, though, I feel like maybe I do need to take better care of myself.
Uh... I'm sorry, Royce, we'll have to keep the rest of our supplies for ourselves. But, let's try to find a way out together.
Hmph, nobody cares about your supplies. Knowing you, they're probably cursed anyway!
And as for finding the exit together — count me out!
With Bennett around, I'm sure any exit I find will only be blocked!
Well... then take care, Royce.
You—
*sigh* ...You take care too Bennett.
This mechanism makes clacking, whirring noises. It appears to be stuck.
Aww... Still not a clue.
Is there really no way out of here apart from that broken mechanism?

dialogue.sit: I'm afraid so...

dialogue.t: Well, guess our only hope now is to wait for help.
The Adventurers' Guild might notice our disappearance and send someone.
Then again, that depends on how lucky we are... If the rescue team takes too long to find us, we might already be...
Ugh, I hate feeling helpless, sitting here waiting for the end to come...

dialogue.sit: ...You really have zero expectations when it comes to luck.
What if help does arrive in time?

dialogue.t: Hmm... Yeah, I am being a bit too pessimistic. No, come on, this isn't like me.
Okay, let's double-check our supplies. Our priority right now is figuring out how long we can hold out.
Take out the dish I packed.
Huh... It's probably a little late for this, but...
...It looks kinda strange. Hmm, was there really something wrong with my cooking?

dialogue.sit: Hate to say, I told you so...
You might get food poisoning if you eat it.

dialogue.t: Ah! This is bad. This is all we've got in terms of supplies.
I should have thought this through more...
Hey, wait a minute...
Maybe we can find another use for it...

dialogue.sit: Like what?

dialogue.t: Long story short...
I once got injured when I was in this severely dangerous place and I got knocked unconscious. I really thought that was going to be the end of me.
But, turns out that's not how it went. Instead, according to Guild Master Cyrus who rescued me...
After I lost consciousness, it was as if my bad luck just stopped affecting me. He took me back to Mondstadt without encountering any trouble at all along the way.
And another time, I got knocked out in a field during a thunderstorm, but then I went the whole night without getting struck by lightning...
I wonder if my bad luck is related to whether I'm awake or not. Or in other words, it might be my consciousness that brings me bad luck.

dialogue.sit: You mean... you want to sacrifice yourself?

dialogue.t: Not really a sacrifice. I was just thinkin'...
Maybe if I eat this strange dish... it's possible that I'll lose consciousness, right?
Once my bad luck is gone, surely help will be here soon!

dialogue.sit: No, you're sacrificing yourself for others again...
Bennett, no way, that's just too tragic!

dialogue.t: Hehe, it's okay. It's better than dragging you and Royce down with me.
You made a great point earlier when you said that I should take better care of myself, but right now, this is a life-or-death situation. Hope you can understand.
Here goes!

dialogue.sit: Bennett!

dialogue.t: The main entrance is shut tightly... There seems to be no way to open it.
The door is shut tightly... There seems to be no way to open it.

quests.description: You should only go adventuring after making sure that you're fully prepared! You and Bennett prepare some food before you challenge the Deserted Ruins of Thermadon.

quests.title: Expansive Eya

dialogue.t: It feels pretty ordinary here... I was expecting some kind of sense of impending doom.
Could it be that because you're here with me, I'm feeling more at ease? Hehe...
I've caught the scent of treasure in the air! Come on, let's go!
It's so dusty. Paimon bets no one has been here in a long, long time.
Hey, that looks like a notebook!
Ah! *cough* *cough* I'm fine... don't let me influence your... thinking...
Ugh... is it over yet... I think I...
Go stand by the mechanism, and when we're both ready, let's trigger them!
This room's setup seems to be somewhat tricky.
The things that stand out are the two mechanisms in front of us, one on the left, and one on the right.
But... it seems like there's some sort of danger lurking around the mechanisms...
If my years of adventure experience are anything to go by, it would be a disaster if we activated the wrong mechanism, haha.
How about letting me try it out first?
Hehe, leave it to me.
Ah, but as you know, I really don't have any luck.
So I'll leave it to you to decide which of these two mechanisms we should trigger.
That's the one I was thinking of, too! Let's see...
*clicking sounds*
What was that noise...?
Oh no! It looks like all the exits are blocked! Guess I still managed to get the wrong one.
This... this is really bad...
Actually, I was thinking of the one on the left, so maybe that means that the one on the right must be the correct one. Let me see...
*clicking sounds*
What was that noise...?
Oh no! It looks like all the exits are blocked! Guess I still managed to get the wrong one.
This... this is really bad...
Hmm... I could try it out myself...
But... What do you think we should do? Let's do it your way!

dialogue.sit: Take one each, activate them simultaneously.

dialogue.t: Well, that's a possibility... yeah.
Let's try it then! I'll take the right side, you take the left!
Oh... so this room has...
...Four mechanisms. Which means...

dialogue.sit: We need four people...
Two of us won't be enough...

dialogue.t: That's what I'm thinking, based on the last room...
I think we're gonna need four people to trigger all the mechanisms at the same time.
Ahhh... If only the rest of Benny's Adventure Team were here...

dialogue.sit: What's the deal with Benny's Adventure Team, anyway?

dialogue.t: ...I hate to admit it, but the truth is... it's gone. It remains in name alone.
The only reason Katheryne hasn't deregistered "Benny's Adventure Team" is because she took pity on me.
In fact... *sigh* the number of adventurers on the team has been below the registration requirements for a long time already.

dialogue.sit: You mean... you're the only one left?
All the other members are gone?

dialogue.t: Haha... yeah. Royce, Heckler, and Jack were all members of Benny's Adventure Team.
A lot of things went down, but mostly it ended because of my bad luck.
I completely understand why they quit the team. I'd never want to put them in danger on my account. *sigh*

dialogue.sit: Don't take it personally.

dialogue.t: Yeah, I felt really let down at first, but I'm pretty much used to it now. It's okay!
Even though I'm the only one left on Benny's Adventure Team... One day, I'm gonna make sure its name is known all over Teyvat!

dialogue.sit: You can do it, Bennett!

dialogue.t: Hehe, thank you.
Let's focus on the problem at hand...
Ah, sorry, the thought of the adventure team got me all sentimental.
Now that I think about it more carefully... Maybe we're making too many assumptions about the solution to these mechanisms.

dialogue.sit: You mean, the solution may be different from the previous room?
You're right, we shouldn't jump to conclusions.

dialogue.t: Exactly. Okay, I'll take a quick look at these mechanisms while you look around for any other clues.
Heh, don't say that! Adventurers should be free to do what they please, so leaving an adventure team is a completely normal thing to do.
Even though I'm the only one left on Benny's Adventure Team... One day, I'm gonna make sure its name is known all over Teyvat!

dialogue.sit: You can do it, Bennett!

dialogue.t: Hehe, thank you.
Let's focus on the problem at hand...
Ah, sorry, the thought of the adventure team got me all sentimental.
Now that I think about it more carefully... Maybe we're making too many assumptions about the solution to these mechanisms.

dialogue.sit: You mean, the solution may be different from the previous room?
You're right, we shouldn't jump to conclusions.

dialogue.t: Exactly. Okay, I'll take a quick look at these mechanisms while you look around for any other clues.
An adventurer's notebook? What's it doing here...?
Maybe it's got some clues on how to crack these mechanisms! Shall we take a look?
Whoa... It really does have some information about them.

dialogue.sit: It's some very valuable guidance.
Why do I feel... it's a bit ominous?

dialogue.t: It seems that the writer is holding something back.
Well, since they've placed their hopes on future adventurers, we can't let them down.
The notes say that the mechanism at the entrance needs to be controlled by someone continuously...
But if the mechanisms are activated in the wrong sequence, the person in charge of the mechanism at the entrance will...

dialogue.sit: Get hurt?

dialogue.t: Yeah, I guess that's what the notes are referring to when they say... "Eric can't hold on anymore"...

dialogue.sit: ...Die?

dialogue.t: Uh... You think so!? Surely it can't be that bad!
It says in the notes that Eric "can't hold on anymore." That at least proves that it is possible to "hold on" up to a point.
Anyway, I'll take that role.

dialogue.sit: Who says it's up to you?
We should at least do rock, paper, scissors...

dialogue.t: Haha, it's okay, it's okay. Getting injured is just part of my daily routine.
I'm pretty used to it by now. At the very least, I should be able to last longer than this Eric guy, haha.
And more importantly, I trust you!
You can definitely crack this mechanism puzzle, right? I mean, come on! You're the great adventurer that I've always admired.

dialogue.sit: Bennett...

dialogue.t: Alright, alright, let's just focus on solving these mechanisms!
Remember what the notes say... Hmm...
"The number of torches is not the hint for the activation sequence..."
"Perhaps... the sequence is related to the position of the torches on the ground."
Well, don't put too much pressure on yourself just because you're afraid I'll get hurt!
Just go with your gut and do it.

dialogue.section: Open the mechanism together with Bennett

dialogue.t: I'm... sorry...
I don't think my body... can... take this anymore...
I'm sorry... I failed you...
Wow, that was quite a haul!
This must be the proudest moment for any adventurer!
Not only getting the chest, but having this golden opportunity to join you on an adventure. For me, that's a pretty major treasure already, hehe...

dialogue.sit: The feeling is mutual.

dialogue.t: Really! Then I'm honored, haha.

dialogue.sit: The chest is the most important thing here.

dialogue.t: Hmm... I guess you're right, finding chests is where the real romance of being an adventurer lies!
But there's one other thing that I find the most amazing of all...
...The fact that nothing really bad happened to us this whole adventure. This is the first time in my whole adventure career that it's ever turned out this way!

dialogue.sit: This is just one of the many possible outcomes.
But it shows that fortunate outcomes do exist.

dialogue.t: That sounds very deep... but I think I get what you're saying.
You are saying that no matter how unlucky I might be, there will always be times when luck is on my side, right?
Yeah... This is a really big thing for me.
And you know, I have a feeling that...
...It was your kindness and goodwill towards me that helped me avoid a lot of bad luck... even find a little good luck...
Hehe, it's a bit embarrassing to say that out loud, but all in all, thank you... for everything!
I hope I get to go on another adventure with you soon!
Cooool! The door is open. We got it right!
Good thing we went with your idea. You definitely live up to your reputation.
And... I haven't had this feeling of working together with friends in ages. I've really missed it, hehe.
Anyway, let's move on!
You... you solved it?
Haha! That's the great adventurer I'm talking about! Awesome!
Let's go and open the chest, shall we? I can't wait!
Oh! Uh... heh, I didn't really do anything. You're the one who nailed this.
Let's go and open the chest, shall we? I can't wait!

quests.description: An adventurer requires naught but courage and strength. The two of you prepare to head directly to the Deserted Ruins of Eya.
